hook: The world's best Sokoban solver, with zero hand-written code.

beats.say: Soksolv solves more Sokoban levels than any published solver on both standard benchmarks, including twenty-four world-first automated solves.
Andrew Healey didn't write a line himself: one fourteen-day Claude Code session ran about four hundred thirty subagents, for roughly three thousand five hundred dollars.
It's also about three point two times faster on the levels other solvers can handle, after fifteen thousand vCPU-hours of research runs.
